name: Program baseline and governance
gate: Schemas, requirement IDs, ADRs, source register and CI documentation checks accepted.

name: Capability and topology inventory
gate: Linux/Windows/macOS nodes publish signed resource, display, audio, input and transport descriptors.

name: Graph core and transaction engine
gate: Typed nodes/ports/links, schema validation, prepare/commit/abort and workspace persistence pass contracts.

name: Linux seat and local media adapters
gate: evdev/uinput/libei and PipeWire/JACK adapters pass pressed-state and RT callback tests.

name: Same-host VM fast paths
gate: Looking Glass/KVMFR, SPICE fallback, virtio input/audio/files and VM lifecycle are one route family.

name: Unified shell, workspaces and focus UX
gate: Graph canvas, simple workspace mode, hotkeys, surface palette, explanations and rollback are usable.

name: Windows and macOS endpoint agents
gate: Signed/minimal helpers expose display, audio, input, capture and virtual-device capabilities.

name: LAN interactive media transport
gate: Sunshine/Moonlight-class adapter plus telemetry and direct QUIC data channels pass wired mixed-load tests.

name: Real-time audio, MIDI and clock domains
gate: Ableton reference route meets admitted xrun/latency budgets under background load.

name: HDR, color and frame pacing
gate: C27HG70 and 2021 M1 Pro paths preserve declared SDR/HDR/color policy with measured frame pacing.

name: Agent realms and surface publishing
gate: Agent can create TTL realm and publish desktop/window/report without stealing focus.

name: Object identity, authority and residency plane
gate: Versioned objects, local SHM store, replicas, spill, provenance and corruption recovery pass tests.

name: Explicit TaskSpec placement scheduler
gate: Build/test/inference/media tasks choose nodes by measured total cost and explain alternatives.

name: Adaptive execution regions and prediction
gate: Fusion/fission, hysteresis, prefetch and speculative execution beat explicit baseline without thrash.

name: Semantic and pixel-proxy application surfaces
gate: RAIL/Xpra/Waypipe adapters and native proxy fallback handle window graphs, IME, DPI and secure fallbacks.

name: WAN, roaming and OOB integration
gate: Congestion adaptation, NAT/relay policy, overlay identities and PiKVM-class recovery pass fault tests.

name: Security, identity and privileged-boundary program
gate: Threat model, mTLS enrollment, capabilities, helper isolation, signing, audit and red-team gates accepted.

name: Observability, benchmark and evidence program
gate: Stage timing, topology snapshots, benchmark corpus, Tracera refs and regression gates run continuously.

name: Packaging, updates and operations
gate: One installer per OS, guided setup, rollback, fleet update rings and recovery docs pass clean-machine tests.

name: Selective atomic interposition research
gate: At least one syscall/function/kernel granule experiment shows positive net benefit and safe fallback; otherwise remains research.

name: Release candidate and acceptance
deps: PF-WP-080, PF-WP-090, PF-WP-100, PF-WP-120, PF-WP-140, PF-WP-150, PF-WP-180
gate: Reference scenarios, security, mixed-load, fault, usability and upgrade gates all pass.
